news.title: White House blocks CNN from pool duty despite judge’s order
news.summary: The White House plans to keep CNN journalists from carrying out the network’s previously scheduled duty providing television pool coverage of President Trump on Thursday, a source familiar with the situation confirmed to The Hill.
